title: Complex structural effects of two hemispheric climatic oscillators on the regional spatio-temporal expansion of a threatened bird
reference: Pablo Almaraz, Juan A. Amat (2004) Complex structural effects of two hemispheric climatic oscillators on the regional spatio-temporal expansion of a threatened bird. Ecology Letters 7: 547–556, DOI: 10.1111/j.1461-0248.2004.00612.x

citation.title: Complex structural effects of two hemispheric climatic oscillators on the regional spatio‐temporal expansion of a threatened bird

figure.label: Population under two climatic oscillators
figure.legend: Live: a logistic population (r = 1) whose carrying capacity k follows two oscillators of periods 3 and 3φ² ≈ 7.85 and their product. Because the ratio of the periods is irrational, the forcing never repeats; the population (amber) trails its carrying capacity (blue) by about 0.6 time units.

scene.system:
x' = r*x*(1 - x/k)
k' = a1*w1*cos(w1*t) + a2*w2*cos(w2*t) + c*(w1*cos(w1*t)*sin(w2*t) + w2*sin(w1*t)*cos(w2*t))
